assumption_statement: parameter_source is derived_release/v1 and nothing above is a measurement. Edge signs come from the rules file with SHA-256 f9474a1be70ea2d008ff842311bd31de50d329eccf53a15d59a4b5b31c2566d0 and rules hash 9cb5aa45c96c1242a642257ab86fca7a7ae24df91159deeb3e48b90d10738ee1 (committed byte for byte as evidence/NAT-02/rules-derive-v1.json): the winning transmitter of an edge is the argmax of the mean predicted probability over its matched T-bar points, mapped acetylcholine +1, gaba -1, glutamate -1, histamine -1, and dopamine, octopamine and serotonin to unknown, with min_probability 0.5 and min_matched_fraction 0.5. Those are predictions attached to presynaptic sites in the release, not measured synaptic actions, and inhibitory glutamate in the fly is an engineering assumption written into the rule basis. The declared unknown_sign policy is exclude, so each of the 2,754,056 edges the rules left unknown contributed weight zero; no sign was guessed and no default substituted, and the other two policies were not exercised here. Strength is the raw release weight divided by the target's body-stats post count (gain 1, normalizer post_total), a declared normalization and not a conductance; weight_scale 21.6 is an engineering choice of units picked so the median applied weight magnitude is about 0.05. bias 0, log_tau 0 and theta_raw 0 are uniform engineering values for every neuron, theta_base is therefore 1.05 for all of them, and every conduction delay is zero: the release carries no per-neuron time constant, threshold or delay and none was derived. dt 1, tau_syn 5, v_reset -0.5, one refractory step and the fast_sigmoid surrogate with scale 2 are the same declared engineering settings as NAT-01 and NAT-02. Null models are in-memory derivatives: neither the graph store nor the parameter set file was read for anything but input and neither was rewritten. The generator is math/rand/v2 rand.New(rand.NewPCG(seed, 0)), recorded as prng "pcg", and the seeds are 1, 2 and 3 for every kind. degree_preserving_rewire proposes the double edge swap (a->b),(c->d) -> (a->d),(c->b), refuses a proposal that would create a self loop first and then one that would repeat an existing pair, and moves only the target array, so every in and out degree is preserved exactly and every edge keeps its own weight and sign; swap_factor 1 is an arbitrary choice of how much rewiring counts as rewired. sign_shuffle permutes the derived sign labels and then applies the same unknown policy, so the +1, -1 and unknown counts are preserved; weight_shuffle permutes the derived strengths and leaves every sign on its own edge. The five thresholds were written into the compare protocol before the matrix was run and were not adjusted afterwards; their values (0.5, 0.1, 0.1, 100 steps, 150 steps) are arbitrary engineering choices, and what a pass means is stated in evidence/NAT-04/verification.json. The metric windows are equally arbitrary: [10,300) starts at the pulse onset, [30,300) starts when the pulse ends and the baseline [10,30) is the pulse window itself, because nothing is injected before step 10 and an earlier baseline would be zero by construction, which would make every activity ratio undefined rather than informative.

limitations: Three seeds per kind. A quantile is one of at most three values a seed really produced and a percentile can only take the values 0, 1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6 and 1. It is a position in a distribution, not a test, and no test was declared before the run.
No behavioural claim. alin, descending_neuron and vnc_motor are annotation labels chosen by the protocol; that they mean anything about fly behaviour is not established here and is not claimed.
One protocol, one stimulus, one core, one unknown-sign policy, one weight_scale, one swap_factor and one machine (macOS arm64). The same matrix on the continuous core is evidence/NAT-05/.

degree_preserving_rewire preserves every in and out degree but not the self loop count: it refuses to create a self loop and can destroy one the graph already has. The import report of this store records 101 self loops and 0 duplicate pairs among the 25,563,197 edges, so at most 101 edges are affected by that asymmetry, and the algorithm requires unique pairs, which this store satisfies.

The rewire keeps the multiset of weights and signs but not their relation to the wiring, and the two shuffles keep the wiring but not the parameters: the three kinds therefore separate different things, and none of them is a control for all of the assumptions at once.

Each cell was executed once. Byte-identical repetition of a compare matrix is verified directly by the package and CLI tests on fixtures, not by a second whole-brain matrix; the only whole-brain repetition here is cell 0 against the NAT-02 run, which matched exactly.

Wall time and maximum resident set size are single samples from a shared machine whose load average was 3.03 before and 2.65 after; this session's own builds and tests ran on it shortly before the matrix.

The 8 GiB accounted limit is an arithmetic bound over the arrays the simulate package allocates. The measured 5,909,626,880 byte maximum resident set size includes the loaded store, the parameter set arrays, Go allocator slack and runtime overhead the accounting deliberately excludes.

The null model reports record topology and parameter hashes so a reader can rebuild each derivative from the store and the seed and compare, but that rebuild was not performed again here from a separate process.
